info.name: Regulatory & Licensing Platform API
info.description:
End-to-end test collection for the Regulatory & Licensing Platform MVP.

Run the whole collection top-to-bottom with the Collection Runner (or `newman run`) against a locally running server (`npm run dev`) to exercise the full application lifecycle: submission -> officer review -> pre-site resubmission -> site visit -> post-site clarification -> approval, plus the role-isolation and validation edge cases from PRD.md.

Each request has test assertions (status code + key response fields) and several chain variables (applicationId, baseRevision, flaggedItemId, etc.) forward automatically via the environment, so requests must run in order within each folder.

Import the accompanying `Regulatory-Licensing-Platform.postman_environment.json` and select it before running.
